title: Shared definitions
description: Encodings with one valid spelling each (docs/specs/vaos-2.0.md section 7, docs/specs/vaos-3.0.md section 6.2 and docs/specs/transparency-log.md section 3.6). Every pattern has an exact length beside it, because in some regex engines $ also matches before a final newline.

hash.description: A SHA-256 hash: 32 bytes as exactly 64 lowercase hex digits.

count.description: A leaf index or tree size: an integer from 0 to 2^53 - 1.

v2Signature.description: v2= and a 64-byte Ed25519 signature in canonical padded standard base64: 86 characters, the last with zero padding bits, then ==; 91 characters in all.

v3Signature.description: v3=, a 64-byte Ed25519 signature in canonical padded standard base64 (88 characters, as in v2=), a literal . and a 3309-byte ML-DSA-65 signature in standard base64 (4412 characters with no padding, since 3309 is a multiple of 3); 4504 characters in all.
